name: Dragon
desc: A rearing winged dragon with spread bat-wings that beat continuously, a lashing spade tail, dorsal spikes and swept horns that hovers, roars fire on the downbeat, headbangs and glides — rendered as brushed sumi ink, glowing ember-forge, faceted wireframe or carved jade.

pose.doc: pose preset; auto = section-driven medley per act

style.doc: aesthetic: brushed sumi wash / molten forge chiaroscuro / faceted x-ray wireframe / carved engraved jade

act.doc: multi-minute pose dramaturgy used when pose=auto
